Acorn KPCJP, Stainless Steel Colonial Cabinet Pull

As beautiful as it is durable, the Stainless Steel Colonial Cabinet Pull is hard crafted by a blacksmith using a hammer and anvil. Its width along with the subtle line detail gives this Acorn made pull an old world feel that is perfect for traditional decors. The natural stainless steel finish is similar to antique nickel or pewter. And because it is handmade, this cabinet pull brings out the beautiful textures and charm of the metal from which it is made.

For over a half a century authenticity and function have been the way Acorn Manufacturing has produced some of the highest quality hand forged hardware and accessories from some of New England's finest Blacksmiths for your home.

Specifications of the Colonial Cabinet Pull:

  • Finish: Stainless Steel
  • Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Length: 4-1/8"
  • Width: 1-1/16"
  • Projection: 1-1/4"
  • Package includes 1 pull and hardware for installation.

Sold individually. Due to the handmade craftsman nature of this product, all dimensions are approximate.
